features.note: Room numbers, abstract poster plates, aisle markings and the facade sign reinforce the multiplex grammar in the intact captures, but the frame-1 and labels-off captures replace large parts of the same scene with opaque slabs, so the promised surface-state coverage is not preserved.

The intact corridor and Sala 3 captures show carpet, aisle lines, red seating proxies, wall panels and abstract screen/poster content; Sala 3 frame 1 is almost entirely occluded, preventing coherent two-frame proof.

Facade, lobby, menus, counter plates and a tall snack-machine-like cue are visible in frame 0, but concessions frame 1 is dominated by giant black and pale planes and the kitchen remains visually close to a generic concession counter.

The engineering overview preserves route colors, endpoint labels and the external IP/Niagara chain, but close terminal direction arrows are too small and visually merge with pale packet/link dashes at the supplied presets.

Architecture and engineering captures are individually legible, but toggling display_frame/poster_frame or labels changes apparent scene coverage: concessions frame 1, corridor labels-off and Sala 3 frame 1 contain giant opaque occluders that are absent from their paired captures.

important_features.note: People, entrance doors, counters, room hardware and the UG67 proxy retain plausible relative scale in the readable captures without visibly inflating the network devices.
Without requiring final lighting at this pass, the bright facade/front-of-house palette and darker burgundy auditorium/corridor palette remain distinguishable in the intact views.
Engineering captures show green and blue routes following the building and roof/service geometry; terminal arrow legibility, not gross route containment, is the remaining surface-level weakness.

defects: Concessions frame 1 is covered by enormous black and pale rectangular planes that erase the counters, menus and most front-of-house context visible from the same camera in frame 0.
Corridor labels-off is dominated by giant black and gray slabs instead of matching the labels-on corridor with only labels removed.
Sala 3 frame 1 is almost completely replaced by white, gray and black planes; the aisle, seats, wall panels and room proportions visible in frame 0 disappear.

Auditorium panels, seals/edge trims and small hardware plates read as sparse flat strips in the intact corridor/Sala views, with several details too small or absent to establish a consistent acoustic-panel rhythm.
The kitchen capture reads primarily as a generic counter-and-menu cluster; equipment, prep, wash and service cues are not varied enough from the concessions view.
Facade breakup is readable through canopy, fascia, glazing bays and mullions, but door hardware, threshold/safety markings and emergency cues remain small and visually ambiguous at the facade preset.
Roof curbs show yellow/white bands and room numbers, but service-access, hazard and flow/direction markings are too sparse to read as a deliberate service-marking system.
Network terminal/direction arrows are not clearly separable from the pale blue packet dashes and other light-blue engineering marks at the supplied UG67 and complete-network presets.
corrections: Fix the surface-state visibility regression so poster_frame, display_frame and labels toggles alter only their intended generated surfaces; preserve every shell, wall, seat, aisle, counter and auditorium proxy at identical transforms and visibility across paired captures.

Re-capture concessions frame 0/1, corridor labels on/off and Sala 3 frame 0/1 from identical cameras and verify that no black, white or gray plane changes size, position or visibility between the pair.
Keep the existing auditorium carpet and aisle layout, then make the acoustic-panel rhythm, edge seals and small hardware plates consistently readable without enlarging them into occluders.
Differentiate the kitchen from concessions with compact generated prep, wash, appliance and service-safety cues while preserving the accepted counter and circulation geometry.
Clarify facade door pulls, threshold/safety bands and emergency hardware at the existing scale, and extend the current canopy/mullion breakup without changing the accepted facade massing.
Add compact, generated roof service-access, hazard and flow-direction markings to the visible curbs and service paths without changing roof geometry.
Increase terminal-arrow contrast and shape distinction from packet dashes, and place the arrows immediately at the readable terminal/link ends in the UG67 and complete-network presets.
